item.title: Parents of Colo. school shooter who used family heirloom revolver won’t be charged
item.description: The Smith and Wesson .38 Special revolver that Desmond Holly used in the attack originally belonged to one of his grandparents and was kept in a safe in the family’s home

item.title: Appeals court rules Tenn. school shooter's writings can be made public
item.description: The appeals court ruled that a lower court's interpretation of public records exceptions, which sided with Covenant School parents seeking to keep the documents private, was overbroad

item.title: Ariz. DPS helicopter crash kills pilot, trooper during shooter response
item.description: A Ranger helicopter crew was responding to assist the Flagstaff PD and other law enforcement agencies when it crashed, killing the pilot and the trooper/paramedic inside

item.title: Va. governor dissolves 287(g) agreements between state LE agencies, ICE
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger ordered the Virginia State Police to end its 287(g) agreement, which deputized officers to work for the federal government

item.title: BWC: Miami man emerges with gun during SRT warrant service before fatal OIS
item.description: The man shot during the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office warrant service was the brother of a man suspected of possessing child pornography; both men worked as TSA agents
